invariants.rationale: Method will throw a NullPointerException if a is null, so valid callers likely always provide non-null a.
Method will throw a NullPointerException if b is null, so valid callers likely always provide non-null b.
Method assumes that a and b are of the same numeric type, as division and type checks are made based on 'a'.

invariants.expression: a instanceof Integer || a instanceof Double
invariants.rationale: Method only supports Integer and Double types; else, it throws an exception.

invariants.expression: a instanceof Integer == b instanceof Integer
invariants.rationale: Implies both a and b are either both Integer or neither, which is required for division without exception.
